title: Library
description: A library of one type in this workspace's layout: features/<scope>/<name>/<type> or shared/<name>/<type>, named <scope>-<name>-<type>, tagged scope:<scope> and type:<type>, with starter files for its type.

name.description: What the library is about, plural for an entity: classes, characters, table.
name.x-prompt: What is the library about (classes, characters, table)?

type.description: The kind of library. It decides the starter files and what the library may import.

items.label: models: types, constants and injection tokens
data-access: API service, store, route resources
ui: presentational components (inputs in, outputs out)

location.description: features (belongs to one area, under a scope) or shared (used by every area).

scope.description: The area a features library belongs to: dnd, auth, sprint-management. Ignored for shared.

singular.description: The entity's singular when the plural's ending doesn't give it (species, people). Derived otherwise: classes -> class.

api.description: Generate the API pieces: the config token (models), API service, list store and route resources (data-access), test providers (testing). Defaults to true for features, false for shared.

apiPath.description: The entity's path under the API base: /classes. Defaults to /<name>.

apiBasePathKey.description: The app config key holding the API base path. Defaults to APP_TTRPG_<SCOPE>__API_BASE_PATH (APP_TTRPG_DND__API_BASE_PATH).

readOnly.description: Reads only: the API service gets list and get, the store has no create, update or delete.

catalog.description: A dnd catalog entity (classes, species, feats, items...): the shared catalog fields and source, /:source/:slug URLs, get by slugs, and ?fields= on the list so it skips the big JSON columns.

requiresLogin.description: feature-shell: every page needs a login (the auth guard on the shell route).
